stem: A delivery truck uses 0.04 gallon of fuel per mile on highways and 0.06 gallon of fuel per mile in cities. On one trip, the truck traveled a total of 300 miles, partly on highways and partly in cities, and used 14 gallons of fuel. How many miles of the trip were in cities?
solution: Let \(c\) be the city miles; then \(300 - c\) miles were on highways.
verify:
c = symbols('c')
ans = solve(Eq(Rational(4, 100)*(300 - c) + Rational(6, 100)*c, 14), c)[0]
assert ans == 100
assert len(spr_answers) == 1 and Rational(spr_answers[0]) == ans
